system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I’d like to change the delivery address for my order #W8665881. Can you have it delivered to Suite 641 instead?

I can help with that — first I need to confirm your identity. Please provide either:
- your email address; or
- your first name, last name, and ZIP code.

Also, to update the delivery address I’ll need the full new address fields. From your message I understand you want “Suite 641” included — please confirm/provide:
- Address line 1 (street)
- Address line 2 (if any; I can put “Suite 641” here)
- City
- State
- ZIP
- Country

Once I have your identity and the full new address I will:
1) look up order #W8665881 and confirm its status,
2) if the order is pending, show you the exact change I will make, and ask you to confirm with a clear “yes” before I submit the update.

Please provide the authentication info and the full address.

Sure, my name is Fatima Johnson and my ZIP code is 78712.

For the address, I just need the package to go to Suite 641 at the same building as before. I don’t want to share more details if possible—can you just add “Suite 641” to the existing delivery address? If you need to confirm the street or city, can you tell me what you have on file and I’ll let you know if it’s correct?

Thanks — I can do that. I tried to look you up by name/ZIP but hit a technical error on my side. To proceed I can either:

- Option A — you provide the email on the account (fastest), or  
- Option B — I retry the name+ZIP lookup now.

Once I can access your account I will:
1) pull up order #W8665881 and confirm its current delivery address and order status,  
2) if the order status is "pending", I will show you the exact address on file and the exact update I plan to make (I would add "Suite 641" into Address line 2), and  
3) ask you to confirm with a clear "yes" before I submit the change.

Which option do you prefer? If you want me to retry the name+ZIP lookup, I’ll do that now. If you’d rather give your email, please provide it and I’ll proceed.
I don’t remember which email I used, so please go ahead and retry the name and ZIP lookup. Thanks.
